warriors.name: Po
warriors.title: Trainee
warriors.bio: The palace's newest arrival. Still figuring things out.

warriors.name: Master Oogway
warriors.title: The Grand Master Emeritus
warriors.bio: Retired long ago to the Peach Tree of Heavenly Wisdom, but never truly left. Speaks in riddles that are somehow always right.

warriors.name: Master Shifu
warriors.title: Grandmaster of the Jade Palace
warriors.bio: Trained the Furious Five. Currently unimpressed by everyone, including himself.

warriors.name: Tigress
warriors.title: Master of the Furious Five
warriors.bio: Trained since infancy. Does not smile. Has never lost a sparring match, or a staring contest.

warriors.name: Monkey
warriors.title: Master of the Furious Five
warriors.bio: Fast, flexible, and always the first to bring snacks to training.

warriors.name: Crane
warriors.title: Master of the Furious Five
warriors.bio: Calm in the air, mildly claustrophobic on the ground.

warriors.name: Viper
warriors.title: Master of the Furious Five
warriors.bio: No arms, no problem. Also the palace's best calligrapher, somehow.

warriors.name: Mantis
warriors.title: Master of the Furious Five
warriors.bio: Small but mighty. Loudly disagrees with this description.

warriors.name: Tai Lung
warriors.title: Corrupted Prodigy
warriors.bio: Once Shifu's finest student, promised the Dragon Scroll and denied it. Broke out of Chorh-Gom Prison specifically to collect what he still believes is his.

warriors.name: Lord Shen
warriors.title: Corrupted Prodigy & Warlord
warriors.bio: Exiled prince of Gongmen City, obsessed with a prophecy about a panda. Rules through cannon fire and refuses to believe fireworks were ever meant for celebration.

warriors.name: General Kai
warriors.title: Overlord of the Spirit Realm
warriors.bio: Once Master Oogway's closest friend in arms, corrupted by jade and banished to the spirit realm for five hundred years. Came back wanting a rematch, badly.

warriors.name: The Chameleon
warriors.title: Shapeshifting Sorceress
warriors.bio: Wears other masters' faces and kung fu as easily as her own. Nobody in the palace archives can agree on what she actually looks like.
